_instructions: 🥗 FRESH BITES WEEKLY MENU — Edit this file every weekend!
_how_to_edit: 1. Change items in 'salads', 'drinks', or 'sauces' arrays below
2. To ADD a new item: copy an existing item, paste it, change the values
3. To REMOVE an item: delete the entire { } block (and the comma before it)
4. For images: put your photo in assets/images/ and update the 'image' path
5. Save this file and push to GitHub — the website updates automatically!
7. Tags: 'veg', 'spicy', 'sweet', 'new', 'protein' — use any combo you want

salads.name: Sprout Salad
salads.description: Fresh moong sprouts tossed with diced capsicum, tomato, green chili, coriander, lemon & a hit of chaat masala. Crunchy, tangy, and packed with protein.

salads.name: Sweet Corn Salad
salads.description: Buttery sweet corn kernels mixed with colourful bell peppers, onion, tomato, fresh coriander & a squeeze of lime. The perfect street-style crunch.

drinks.name: Hibiscus Drink
drinks.description: Refreshing ruby-red hibiscus flower drink served ice-cold. Naturally tangy, lightly sweetened, and beautifully vibrant. Your new favourite cooldown.

sauces.name: Sweet Beetroot Sauce
sauces.description: Our signature smooth, sweet beetroot dip — earthy, vibrant pink, and the perfect creamy companion to every salad bowl.

sauces.name: Spicy Coriander Sauce
sauces.description: Bold, fiery green chutney made with fresh coriander, green chili & a secret spice blend. Not for the faint-hearted. 🔥
